issue_request: FHIR-17564 was a Published Patient Care STU3 change request asking to rename FamilyMemberHistory.gender to birthSex. The final Not Persuasive with Modification decision rejected birthSex as too precise for commonly reported family-history information, kept the then-current gender name, and required a comment warning that the information ideally reflects genetic sex but may be imprecise.

Later source rework preserved the content in source/familymemberhistory/structuredefinition-FamilyMemberHistory.xml, and later FHIR-17780 renamed the element from gender to sex while adapting the same comment to sex/genetic sex wording.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini.
